name: get_content
description: Return the content of a file by path relative to the git project root. When the patch merges several changes, a path may start with the ReviewAI origin prefix of a change (`reviewai-topic-change-<N>/<project>/`) to address that change's repository at its current patch set; paths without a prefix address the primary change.

file_path.description: Repository-tracked file path relative to the git project root.
